# Run on Simafri

:::warning
This method is not officially supported.
:::

[Simafri](https://www.simafri.com/en/) offers managed VPS hosting and publishes a step-by-step guide to run Komga on a VPS with Docker Compose, behind an HTTPS reverse proxy, including OPDS, Kobo Sync, KOReader Sync, backups and updates. See the [Komga self-hosting guide](https://www.simafri.com/en/guides/self-host-komga/).
